note: THE PROVENANCE RECORD FOR EVERY THIRD-PARTY FILE UNDER `roots`, AND THE THING THAT MAKES IT CHECKABLE. `packages/web/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` recorded `Simple Icons v15.0.0, vendored 2026-07-06` from the day the icons landed, and nothing verified it: `simple-icons` is not a dependency in any manifest, the files were fetched by a script and committed, and a recorded version with no way to check it is a measurement that reads as current state forever. B7 found the same failure one directory up, where the thirteen vendored AI-tool marks were recorded as Simple Icons content and nine of thirteen were not. This file is the machine-readable half; `npm run vendored-assets:check` recomputes the digests, refuses a file nothing declares, and fails when the notices file and this one disagree. Adding a vendored file is an edit to this file alone.

outOfScope.why: Six Claude Code and Codex brand-mark PNGs with no attribution or notice anywhere. ADR 005 section 6 flags them for the same qualified legal review as the typeface, and precondition P2 addresses them to outside counsel. They are named here rather than omitted so a reader can see they are known and unresolved, not overlooked. They are outside `roots` and this gate does not judge them.

collections.why: The product sans and display face at 300/400/500/600, named by the `@font-face` block in `packages/web/src/app.css`. Vendored under stable names rather than imported through the bundler so the dashboard package and the site can serve fixed URLs; a content-hashed name would break those hand-written `@font-face` blocks.
collections.verification: Each file is byte-identical to the cut the pinned `@fontsource/figtree` ships, checked by `node packages/web/scripts/sync-fonts.mjs --check`. Identity against a pinned dependency rather than against a network fetch is what makes this verifiable offline, and it is the same relation `packages/dashboard/scripts/build-package.mjs` asserts before it will stage a font binary at all.

collections.why: Private control-plane copy of the same four Figtree cuts. ADR 005 stage B4 required the control plane's `[assets]` directory to resolve inside `packages/control-plane` rather than bind `../web/public`; `htmlStyles.ts` names `/fonts/Figtree-*.woff` literally. Bytes match `figtree-web`; the digest differs because the collection digest includes path.
collections.verification: Each file is byte-identical to the matching file under `packages/web/public/fonts`, which `figtree-web` already pins to `@fontsource/figtree` 5.3.0 via `sync-fonts.mjs --check`.

collections.why: Stack and toolchain badges rendered in Compare and related views: descriptive identification of a detected value, not endorsement. The collection is CC0-1.0; individual logo trademarks remain with their respective owners, which the notices file states and which no digest can settle.
collections.verification: Every one of the 72 files was fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at tag 15.0.0 using the slug map in the resync script and compared byte for byte, ignoring a trailing newline. All 72 were identical. That is what `verifiedAgainstUpstreamOn` records; the digest is what makes any later drift from those exact bytes fail offline.

collections.resync: node packages/web/scripts/make-loop.mjs --in <source.mp3> --out loop.wav, then the two ffmpeg lines in that script header
collections.why: The marketing site ambient bed, named in TRACK_SOURCES by packages/web/src/marketing/audio/engine.ts. Served from fixed URLs rather than imported through the bundler because the <audio> element resolves them as plain hrefs, and because the engine must be able to find them absent and degrade to interface ticks.
collections.verification: NOT byte-identical to upstream, and the entry says so rather than implying a fetch would reproduce it. These two files are an 84-second seamless loop cut from the 3-minute original by packages/web/scripts/make-loop.mjs, which finds the loop point by waveform correlation, then encoded to AAC and MP3. The 3-minute source is not vendored; like the hero figure art, the heavy original stays out of the repository. What is verifiable here is the licence, recorded at packages/web/LICENSES/Pixabay-ambient-570708.txt, and the digest over the two shipped files.

removed.what: Thirteen AI-tool marks formerly at packages/web/public/assets/*.svg
removed.why: ADR 005 required them re-synced from a pinned simple-icons version or replaced by a text glyph. B7 measured every file against upstream and the re-sync is not achievable: simple-icons carries no `visualstudiocode`, `aider`, `amazonq`, `continue`, `zed`, or `codex` at v15.0.0 or at master, only five of the thirteen were simple-icons content at all, and two were third-party marks from a source nobody recorded. src/lib/toolMeta.ts now renders the letter fallback for every tool. The per-file measurement is in packages/web/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. This entry exists so the next reader finds the finding rather than an absence.
